<p align="center">Seed. Coil. Lantern. A warm beam crosses the garden and threads through the northern pines.</p>

<p align="center">Below you, one lantern after another flickers awake. The greenhouse shines. The pump hums. The house feels like a place that is being lived in again.</p>

<p align="center">The ghost reaches the top stair with two cups. &quot;You can go home,&quot; it says. &quot;Or there is still that spare desk.&quot;</p>
